notes_for_editor: Thin record: one January 1922 newspaper item (via the Forest Lookouts page), the Forest Fire Lookout Association row, and the Forest Service wilderness page. No build year, design, staffing or removal date found. The FFLA row gives coordinates as Undetermined; the record point (39.38127, -122.77277) came from West US Lookouts and was not checked here. Do not merge with the Oregon Snow Mountain lookout (Grant County, Ochoco/Malheur National Forests, station noted in 1915: https://oregonlookouts.weebly.com/snow-mountain.html), which is a different tower. Two web searches used; no current source for this site was found beyond the wilderness page.
